title: PII detector rule-ID catalog
description: Closed catalog of dotted rule_ids emitted into MatchAuditRecord.ruleID by every Swift detector that produces a PII match. One row per (detector, variant) pair; each row pins (rule_id, family, detector, version, source_artifact, is_checksum_gated). Every Swift detector symbol that wires into MatchAuditRecord.ruleID must map to at least one catalog entry, verified by test. Version-bump policy: bump the per-row `version` on behavior-changing edits to the underlying Swift detector, which an engine-code-hash check flags automatically. Major-version bumps roll the v-tag in `rule_id` (e.g., `pii.foo.v1` → `pii.foo.v2`). An addendum (`pii.dd.v1` + `pii.audit.v1` + `pii.icn.v1`) extends this V1 baseline, which ships only currently-implemented detectors. Wrapper shape ({version, generated_by, seed, entries}) matches the established context_keywords / passport_patterns / institutions / address_components gazetteer precedent.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the wrapper shape or per-row required-field set changes in a way the Swift decoder must observe.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed recorded for reproducibility. Unused by this builder (deterministic transcription); preserved for uniformity across artifacts.

entries.description: Catalog rows in ascending rule_id order. The shipping set is closed at the V1 detector tree; an addendum adds `pii.dd.v1` + `pii.audit.v1` + `pii.icn.v1` separately.

rule_id.description: Dotted lowercase rule identifier emitted into MatchAuditRecord.ruleID. Shape: `pii.<category>(.<variant>)?.v<int>` — the variant segment is optional (used for algorithmic variants like `state_machine`, `luhn`, `checksum`). The major-version v-tag is required and rolls only on rule_id-breaking changes; minor edits bump the per-row `version` field instead.

family.description: Top-level family namespace. V1 ships PII detection only; future families (e.g., `metadata`, `document_class`) would extend the enum.

detector.description: Name of the Swift detector class or struct (matches a `<name>.swift` file under resecta/Packages/RedactionEngine/Sources/RedactionEngine/Detection/). Detectors implemented as PIIDetector instance methods carry `PIIDetector` here — disambiguation is the rule_id.

version.description: Per-row semver-style version. Bumps on behavior-changing edits to the underlying Swift detector, tracked by an engine-code-hash check. V1 baseline = `1.0`.

source_artifact.description: When the detector is gazetteer-backed, the relative filename under build/ that names the gazetteer (e.g., `dl_patterns.json`, `passport_patterns.json`). Null when the detector is regex-only or checksum-only with no external data dependency.

is_checksum_gated.description: True when the detector requires a structurally validated checksum to fire (Luhn, NPI Luhn-80840, DEA letter-checksum). False for state-machine, regex-only, NLTagger, or context-scored detectors. The SSN state-machine path is `false` — a state machine isn't a checksum.
